summary: Fix boat-picking so twilight/overnight/1.5-day bookings stop failing when no boat is actually scheduled, and switch cheap-class booking to per-class trailing rate (was pooling all cheap classes, which buried a 3-week three-quarter hot streak under dead HD_AM/HD_PM signal); also dropped a dead same-day bonus-booking branch and an over-cautious doy-window PTO gate.
describe: Reactive momentum, no weather. Tracks yellowtail kept+released per angler over the last 2-3 days separately for each trip class (half day AM/PM, three-quarter, full day, twilight, overnight, 1.5-day), so a hot class is not diluted by dead ones. At 21:00, books tomorrow's bookable cheap-class offer with the best positive trailing rate. At 16:00, books today's twilight trip whenever any cheap class shows a positive rate (twilight never costs PTO), and books the better of overnight/1.5-day when the premium trailing rate is positive. Weekday PTO for the date 14 days out is committed whenever the best trailing rate across all classes is positive, keeping a 1-day reserve. Every booking is checked against the actual sailing schedule for that class and day and against budget before booking, using the scheduled boat that ran the class most recently, falling back to any scheduled boat if that pick is not actually running. A run of skunks stops booking naturally since every signal only looks a few days back.
